sampling.mapping: normal quantile directions normalized; independent radial coordinate u**(1/nx)
sampling.distribution: uniform in volume on ball, not surface or cube

initializations: start0 balanced regular simplex with seeded0.01-radius jitter; remaining7 uniform-ball starts
solver: SLSQP with analytic loss and constraint Jacobians; direct coordinates expressed in radius units; no response transformation
constraints: norm(unit_anchor)<=1 and all pair separations>=1e-4; exact final ball feasibility and affine rank nx independently certified
candidate_retention: best structurally feasible objective evaluation within each start, including initial/final; retain solver convergence diagnostics separately
selection: minimum calibration error among converged structurally valid starts; ties by start index; if none, archive best feasible/available start and mark invalid
validation: generate independent holdout only after selection; never reselect/restart using holdout or signed correlation
precision_check: each cal/validation correlation entry differs from exact uniform-ball population correlation by at most0.005; diagnostic acceptance only after selection
signed_correlation: observed covariate only; no target, constraint or selection criterion
